_doc: The Character Advancement window's data (artifacts/ui_audit/advancement/plan.md): every word a player sees on it, the tree split and its titles, the layout constants, the colours and the switches. Read through AdvancementData (word, words, layout, color, switch); nothing in scripts/ui/advancement/ hard-codes a player-facing word, a number or a colour.

Phase A (the owner, 2026-10-09: 'Yes, as a preview first') and B1/B2 (docs/tidebreak/loadouts_live.md): the window saves loadouts (user://advancement.json, AdvancementStore). A worn loadout changes a match only through the picks data/bending/loadout_apply.json makes live (7 number nodes and the Boxing class); those carry a green dot and say so in their tip, the ribbon says the rest is a preview (AdvancementData.is_live reads that file, read only).
words: the window's words. Format strings use GDScript's % (%s a word, %d a number). No word from the show, no 'bending' (tests/ring/test_player_words.gd), no third-party game's names.

text_overrides: player text shown in place of data/sway/skill_tree.json's (a draft other work owns), by node id (name, effect, plus, minus, help, answer) and by starter loadout id (name, line): 'bends'/'bend' read as 'curves'/'curve' (the banned word), and the snow column is named Snowstorm in this window (the draft's name is also a game company's and a famous spell's). Drop an override once the tree's own text changes.

tree: the split (left = the moves a style shapes, titled with the style; right = dash, wall, heal, the passive and the skill set, titled with the element's skill set), the chip order, the kind tiers of the lattice (AdvancementLayout, tools/ui/advancement_layout.py) and the choice kinds (one per move-mode / slot / loadout, drawn as one octagon).

layout: authored at 1600x900 (the window scales by min(w/1600, h/900)); zones are [x, y, w, h] in authored pixels; icon, pitch_x, pitch_y in pixels; band_gap in rows; left_width / right_width in slots; a tree taller or wider than its zone shrinks its pitch down to min_pitch_x / min_pitch_y.

switches: gates (first_win: everything locked until the first ring win; full_lessons: the kinds in full_lessons_kinds locked until the Full lessons are done; skipped_counts: a skipped lesson counts as done, as RingLessons treats it; the user arg adv_gates=off opens both), show_held (held nodes drawn dashed with '?', never wearable), hide_world_only_in_ring, gate_every_band (the lessons gate line on every band, else on the first), pickable_states (styles a player may pick), first_only_schemes (control schemes that reach only each key's first move: their loadouts grey every tap-twice node).

class.title: Change class

power.label: Power

power.down: grown and tap-twice moves hit 10% softer

mobility.label: Mobility

gates.first_win_tip: Opens after your first ring win
gates.full_tip: Twists, techniques, new skills and skill sets open after the Full lessons: %d left

water.lash.long_reach.effect: The Lash reaches 19 m (from 16), but Flowing curves it 12° at most (from 15°).
water.lash.long_reach.help: A longer Lash that curves a little less.

water.passive.lazy_river.effect: Flowing: your water curves up to 18° (from 15°) for 0.3 s (from 0.25), but turns at 36°/s (from 45°/s).
water.passive.lazy_river.help: Your water curves farther but turns more slowly.

water.passive.rapids.effect: Flowing: your water turns at 54°/s (from 45°/s), but curves 12° at most (from 15°).
water.passive.rapids.help: Your water turns faster but curves less.

air.frost.blizzard.name: Snowstorm
air.frost.blizzard.help: Tap 4 twice: a snowstorm where you aim.

air.frost.whiteout.effect: Home ground: standing on your own crust or in your Snowstorm, your locks fill x1.15. Patch's lock is 1.7 s (from 1.5).

water.turn.cleanse.effect: Your Turn, perfect or late, clears gas within 2.2 m of you. Turn's lock is 0.24 s (from 0.2).

fire.step.ignite.effect: Your Step leaves a 2 m line of fire for 1.5 s (at most 3% to a foe who stands in it: jump it). Stepping in goes 9 m/s (from 10).

fire.parry.hold_storm.effect: After a perfect Parry of Lightning, hold E up to 0.8 s: the bolt waits in your arms and leaves along your aim when you let go (x1.2 as before). A perfect Parry of fire now goes back at x1.1 (from x1.2).

air.slot.dust.effect: A 3 m cloud of dust where you aim (2-6 m, placed like a wall, never round you) for 2.5 s that blocks sight both ways, like Breath's smoke. Lock 0.9 s; a new one ends your old one. Trade: your Wind Wall stands 3.5 s (from 4).

earth.shove.split.effect: One Shove breaks into three stones in flight.

earth.burrow.surfacing.effect: You come up hitting: a stomp ring where you surface.

earth.lift.ramp.effect: Lift raises a tilted slab under you and throws you farther forward and lower.

earth.slot.shell.effect: Four short slabs close round you for a moment: every shot stops on them.

water.splash.jet.effect: Splash becomes a stream of six small bolts.

water.lash.reel.effect: The Lash pulls him toward you instead of pushing.

water.surf.breaker.effect: Surf ends in a small wave where you stop.

water.wall.shatter.effect: Lash your own Ice Wall and it bursts into ice shards.

water.slot.bubble.effect: A sphere of water round you douses fire and swallows water and air.

fire.kick.twin.effect: One Kick sends two narrower floor waves.

fire.breath.clean_burn.effect: Breath leaves no smoke and is wider.

air.slip.gust_step.effect: Your Slip shoves whoever you pass aside.

water.preset.riptide.line: Turn his water back when you choose, curve what you throw, own the steam.
